articles.title_en: Optimal contest design: Tuning the heat
articles.title_cn: 最优竞赛设计：调节热度
articles.abstract_en: We consider the design of contests when the principal can choose both the prize profile and how the prizes are allocated as a function of a possibly noisy signal about the agents' efforts. We provide sufficient conditions that guarantee optimality of a contest. Optimal contests have a minimally competitive prize profile and an intermediate degree of competitiveness in the contest success function. Whenever observation is not too noisy, the optimum can be achieved by an all-pay contest with a cap. When observation is perfect, the optimum can also be achieved by a nested Tullock contest. We relate our results to a recent literature which has asked similar questions but has typically focused on the design of either the prize profile or the contest success function.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当委托人可以选择奖金分配方案以及如何根据可能包含噪声的关于代理人努力程度的信号来分配奖金时的竞赛设计问题。我们提供了保证竞赛最优性的充分条件。最优竞赛具有最小竞争性的奖金分配方案和中等程度的竞赛成功函数竞争性。当观测噪声不太大时，最优可以通过带有上限的全支付竞赛实现。当观测完美时，最优也可以通过嵌套的图洛克竞赛实现。我们将我们的结果与近期文献联系起来，这些文献提出了类似的问题，但通常侧重于奖金分配方案或竞赛成功函数的设计。

articles.title_en: Strategy-proof and envy-free mechanisms for house allocation
articles.title_cn: 住房分配中的防策略与无嫉妒机制
articles.abstract_en: We consider the problem of allocating indivisible objects to agents when agents have strict preferences over objects. There are inherent trade-offs between competing notions of efficiency, fairness and incentives in such assignment mechanisms. It is, therefore, natural to consider mechanisms that satisfy two of these three properties in their strongest notions, while trying to improve on the third dimension. In this paper, we are motivated by the following question: Is there a strategy-proof and envy-free random assignment mechanism more efficient than equal division?
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当代理人对物品具有严格偏好时，将不可分割物品分配给代理人的问题。在此类分配机制中，效率、公平和激励等相互竞争的概念之间存在固有的权衡。因此，自然要考虑在最强意义上满足这三个属性中的两个，同时试图改进第三个维度的机制。在本文中，我们受以下问题驱动：是否存在比均等分配更有效的防策略且无嫉妒的随机分配机制？

articles.title_en: A complete characterization of infinitely repeated two-player games having computable strategies with no computable best response under limit-of-means payoff
articles.title_cn: 极限平均收益下具有可计算策略且无可计算最优响应的无限重复两人博弈的完整刻画
articles.abstract_en: It is well-known that for infinitely repeated games, there are computable strategies that have best responses, but no computable best responses. These results were originally proved for either specific games (e.g., Prisoner's dilemma), or for classes of games satisfying certain conditions not known to be both necessary and sufficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，对于无限重复博弈，存在具有最优响应但无可计算最优响应的可计算策略。这些结果最初是针对特定博弈（如囚徒困境）或满足某些条件且未知其既必要又充分的博弈类别证明的。

articles.title_en: Signaling, screening, and core stability
articles.title_cn: 信号传递、筛选与核心稳定性
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a noncooperative approach to core stability in an economy with incomplete information. We study the perfect Bayesian equilibria of an extensive form mechanism that extends the one used by Serrano and Vohra (1997) to implement the core of a complete-information economy. This leads to a version of the core that we refer to as the sequential core, which allows for information to be transmitted among the agents during the process of coalition formation. Such information flows include proposals that can be viewed as signaling devices and/or screening contracts. Equilibrium refinements are then used to provide justifications for the coarse core and the fine core. As a robustness check, we show that the sequential core corresponds to stationary PBE outcomes of an infinite horizon bargaining game.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一种在信息不完全的经济中研究核心稳定性的非合作方法。我们研究了一个扩展型机制的完美贝叶斯均衡，该机制扩展了Serrano和Vohra（1997）用于实施完全信息经济核心的机制。这引出了我们称之为序贯核心的核心版本，它允许在联盟形成过程中信息在代理人之间传递。这种信息流包括可被视为信号传递工具和/或筛选合同的提议。然后使用均衡精炼来为粗核心和细核心提供合理性论证。作为稳健性检验，我们表明序贯核心对应于无限期讨价还价博弈的平稳PBE结果。

articles.title_en: Money-metrics in local welfare analysis: Pareto improvements and equity considerations
articles.title_cn: 地方福利分析中的货币度量：帕累托改进与公平考量
articles.abstract_en: We identify local Pareto improvements from a valuation equilibrium, and extend the results of Hirshleifer, Arrow-Lind, Milleron, and Radner on the evaluation of small projects to behavioral or nonstandard choice models. We use the sign of directional derivative of the sum of McKenzie-Samuelson money metrics to evaluate small projects, but, rather than assume its differentiability, furnish preference conditions that guarantee it. Our methods yield, as an unintended consequence, (i) a refutation of Samuelson's (1974) conjecture that the money metric is locally concave in a neighborhood of a demand point, thereby settling an issue open for five decades; and (ii) a substantive extension of the 1988 Blackorby-Donaldson theorem that the money metric is concave in consumption only if preferences are quasihomothetic. We explain some equity implications of our local-welfare result, and as part of the rehabilitation of money metrics, suggest a case for using a second-order approximation to a money metric for local welfare. We illustrate when our results hold and don't hold with several non-standard choice models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从估值均衡中识别出局部帕累托改进，并将Hirshleifer、Arrow-Lind、Milleron和Radner关于小项目评估的结果扩展到行为或非标准选择模型。我们使用McKenzie-Samuelson货币度量之和的方向导数符号来评估小项目，但并非假设其可微性，而是提供保证其可微性的偏好条件。我们的方法作为意外结果，产生了（i）对Samuelson（1974）关于货币度量在需求点邻域内局部凹性的猜想的反驳，从而解决了悬而未决五十年之久的问题；（ii）对Blackorby-Donaldson（1988）定理的实质性扩展，该定理认为货币度量仅在偏好拟位似时才是消费的凹函数。我们解释了局部福利结果的一些公平含义，并在货币度量复兴的背景下，建议使用货币度量的二阶近似进行局部福利分析。我们通过几个非标准选择模型说明了我们的结果何时成立及何时不成立。

articles.title_en: Strength of preference over complementary pairs axiomatizes alpha-MEU preferences
articles.title_cn: 互补对上的偏好强度公理化α-最大最小期望效用偏好
articles.abstract_en: Preferences over acts have an α-Maxmin Expected Utility (α-MEU) representation if they can be represented by the α-mixture of the worst and the best expected utility over a set of priors. The case α=1 is the Maxmin Expected Utility (MEU) model characterized in Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989).
articles.abstract_cn: 如果行为上的偏好可以通过对一组先验上的最差和最好期望效用的α-混合来表示，则它们具有α-最大最小期望效用（α-MEU）表示。α=1的情形是Gilboa和Schmeidler（1989）中刻画的最大最小期望效用（MEU）模型。

articles.title_en: Best-response dynamics in directed network games
articles.title_cn: 有向网络博弈中的最优反应动态
articles.abstract_en: We study public goods games played on networks with possibly non-reciprocal relationships between players. These include one-sided relationships, mutual but unequal relationships, and parasitism. It is known that many learning processes converge to the game's Nash equilibrium if interactions are reciprocal, but this is not true in general for directed networks. Under one-sided and parasitic relationships, best-response dynamics may cycle. The production of the locally public good of players may fail to converge to an equilibrium, making static analysis less insightful in an applied setting. In this paper we show that the strong convergence results of the undirected case are retained for two economically relevant classes of directed networks: those with transitive relative importance of players and those rescalable into networks with weak externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在玩家之间可能存在非互惠关系的网络上进行的公共品博弈。这些关系包括单向关系、互惠但不平等的关系以及寄生关系。已知在许多学习过程中，如果互动是互惠的，则会收敛到博弈的纳什均衡，但对于有向网络，这通常不成立。在单向和寄生关系下，最优反应动态可能会循环。玩家本地公共品的生产可能无法收敛到均衡，这使得静态分析在应用环境中缺乏洞察力。在本文中，我们证明了无向情况下的强收敛结果对于两类经济上有意义的有向网络仍然成立：那些具有传递性相对重要性的玩家网络和那些可重新缩放为弱外部性网络的网络。

articles.title_en: Talent, basic research and growth
articles.title_cn: 人才、基础研究与增长
articles.abstract_en: Due to the public good nature of basic research, the mechanisms for rewarding talent are very different from those prevailing in the production of applied research by private actors. We develop a growth model in which such mechanisms are taken explicitly into account. This allows us to address the following fundamental questions: how do policies in the public research sector influence the effort and risk-taking decisions of researchers of different talent? How do these choices affect the aggregate production of basic research? What is the final impact on growth? The analysis shows that the design of research evaluation policies crucially affects both the long run rate of growth and the relationship between taxation and growth. A key and novel channel through which this occurs is the effect of basic research policy on the expected non-monetary benefits from being a researcher.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于基础研究的公共产品性质，人才奖励机制与私人行为者进行应用研究的机制大不相同。我们构建了一个增长模型，明确考虑了这些机制。这使我们能够解决以下基本问题：公共研究部门的政策如何影响不同才能研究者的努力和风险承担决策？这些选择如何影响基础研究的总体产出？对增长的最终影响是什么？分析表明，研究评估政策的设计对长期增长率和税收与增长之间的关系都有至关重要的影响。实现这一影响的一个关键且新颖的渠道是基础研究政策对研究者预期非货币收益的影响。

articles.title_en: Information design for selling search goods and the effect of competition
articles.title_cn: 销售搜索品的信息设计及竞争效应
articles.abstract_en: I study optimal information provision by a search goods seller. While the seller controls a consumer's pre-search information, he cannot control post-search information because the consumer will inevitably learn the product's match after search. A relaxed problem approach is developed to solve the optimal design, which accommodates both continuous value distributions and ex-ante heterogeneous consumers with privately known outside options. The optimal design is shown to crucially depend on the outside option value distribution, and can be implemented by a simple upper-censorship signal under certain regularity conditions. Several applications are provided, including comparing information designs for search goods and experience goods, and studying the effect of competition with a large number of sellers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了搜索品销售者的最优信息提供。虽然销售者控制消费者的搜索前信息，但他无法控制搜索后信息，因为消费者在搜索后不可避免地会了解产品的匹配度。我开发了一种松弛问题方法来求解最优设计，该方法同时适用于连续价值分布和具有私人已知外部选项的事前异质消费者。结果表明，最优设计关键取决于外部选项价值分布，并且在某些正则条件下可以通过简单的上限截断信号来实现。我提供了几个应用，包括比较搜索品和体验品的信息设计，以及研究大量销售者竞争的影响。

articles.title_en: Testing negative value of information and ambiguity aversion
articles.title_cn: 信息负价值与模糊厌恶的检验
articles.abstract_en: The standard Subjective Expected Utility model of decision-making implies that information can never have a negative value ex-ante. Many ambiguity theories have since questioned this property. We provide an experimental test of the connection between the value of information and ambiguity attitude. Our results show that the value of information can indeed be negative when new information renders hedging against ambiguity impossible. Moreover, the value of information is correlated with ambiguity aversion. This confirms the predictions from ambiguity theories and may have implications for decision-making in uncertain and dynamic environments. Neither complexity avoidance nor information with ambiguous reliability can reproduce the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准的主观期望效用决策模型意味着信息在事前不可能具有负价值。许多模糊理论自此对这一性质提出了质疑。我们提供了一个关于信息价值与模糊态度之间联系的实验检验。我们的结果表明，当新信息使得针对模糊性的对冲变得不可能时，信息价值确实可能为负。此外，信息价值与模糊厌恶相关。这证实了模糊理论的预测，并可能对不确定和动态环境中的决策产生影响。复杂性规避和具有模糊可靠性的信息都不能重现这些结果。

articles.title_en: The folk theorem for the prisoner's dilemma with endogenous private monitoring
articles.title_cn: 内生私人监督下囚徒困境的民间定理
articles.abstract_en: We study the repeated prisoner's dilemma with private monitoring under the assumption that the monitoring structure is endogenously chosen by the players in each period. We allow the players to choose from all possible monitoring structures. If the players disagree on the monitoring structure they would like, the realized monitoring structure is determined by a function that aggregates their choices. When one player can dictate the monitoring structure, then the repetition of the stage Nash is the only sequential equilibrium outcome. In contrast, when no player can dictate the monitoring structure, we provide conditions on the aggregation function under which any strictly individually rational and feasible payoff vector can be supported in sequential equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在每期监督结构由参与者内生选择的假设下，具有私人监督的重复囚徒困境。我们允许参与者从所有可能的监督结构中进行选择。如果参与者对期望的监督结构意见不一致，则实际实现的监督结构由汇总其选择的函数决定。当某一参与者能够主导监督结构时，阶段纳什均衡的重复是唯一的序贯均衡结果。相反，当没有参与者能够主导监督结构时，我们提供了汇总函数的条件，在这些条件下，任何严格个体理性且可行的支付向量都可以在序贯均衡中得到支持。

articles.title_en: Linear Riley equilibria in quadratic signaling games
articles.title_cn: 二次信号博弈中的线性Riley均衡
articles.abstract_en: We study signaling games with quadratic payoffs. As signaling games admit multiple separating equilibria, many equilibrium selection rules are proposed and a well-known solution is Riley equilibria. They are separating equilibria in which the sender achieves the highest equilibrium payoff for all types among all separating equilibria. We analyze the conditions for Riley equilibria to be linear, a common assumption in many applications. We derive a sufficient and necessary condition for the existence and uniqueness of linear Riley equilibria. We apply the result to confirm the dominance of linear equilibria in some classic examples, and we show that, in some other examples, there exist previously unknown nonlinear Riley equilibria.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有二次收益的信号博弈。由于信号博弈允许多个分离均衡，许多均衡选择规则被提出，其中著名的解是Riley均衡。它们是分离均衡，其中发送者在所有分离均衡中对所有类型获得最高的均衡收益。我们分析了Riley均衡为线性的条件，这是许多应用中的常见假设。我们推导了线性Riley均衡存在且唯一的充分必要条件。我们将结果应用于确认一些经典例子中线性均衡的主导地位，并表明在其他一些例子中，存在先前未知的非线性Riley均衡。

articles.title_en: Co-essentiality of money and credit: A mechanism-design view
articles.title_cn: 货币与信用的共同本质性：一种机制设计视角
articles.abstract_en: Under what conditions are money and credit jointly essential for trade? We answer this question by applying a mechanism-design approach to a standard monetary search model, augmented with two types of credit technologies. First, payment can be enforced up to some exogenous amount (enforcement-based credit). Second, default on past promises can be partially monitored by future trading partners (monitoring-based credit). We characterize implementable allocations subject to individual rationality and bilateral efficiency of trades. Consistent with prior literature, we find that money and monitoring-based credit cannot be jointly essential. However, we show that money and enforcement-based credit are jointly essential as long as neither payment instrument by itself is sufficient to implement a first-best. Money is memory, but it is not enforcement.
articles.abstract_cn: 在什么条件下，货币和信用对于交易是共同本质性的？我们通过将机制设计方法应用于一个标准货币搜寻模型来回答这个问题，该模型增加了两种类型的信用技术。首先，支付可以被强制执行到某个外生金额（基于强制执行的信用）。其次，对未来承诺的违约可以被未来的交易伙伴部分监控（基于监控的信用）。我们刻画了受制于个体理性和交易双边效率的可实施配置。与先前文献一致，我们发现货币和基于监控的信用不能共同本质性。然而，我们表明，只要任何一种支付工具本身不足以实现最优，货币和基于强制执行的信用就是共同本质性的。货币是记忆，但它不是强制执行。

articles.title_en: On sustainable equilibria
articles.title_cn: 论可持续均衡
articles.abstract_en: Following the ideas laid out in Myerson (1996), Hofbauer (2003) defined a Nash equilibrium of a finite game as sustainable if it can be made the unique Nash equilibrium of a game obtained by deleting/adding a subset of the strategies that are inferior replies to it. This paper proves a result about sustainable equilibria and uses it to provide a refinement as well. Our result concerns the Hofbauer-Myerson conjecture about the relationship between the sustainability of an equilibrium and its index: for a generic class of games, an equilibrium is sustainable iff its index is +1. von Schemde and von Stengel (2008) proved this conjecture for bimatrix games; we show that the conjecture is true for all finite games. More precisely, we prove that an equilibrium is isolated and has index +1 if and only if it can be made unique in a larger game obtained by adding finitely many strategies that are inferior replies to that equilibrium. It follows in a straightforward way from our result that sustainable equilibria fail the Decomposition Axiom for games as formulated by Mertens (1989a). In order to rectify this problem we propose a refinement, called strongly sustainable equilibria, which is shown to exist for all regular games.
articles.abstract_cn: 遵循Myerson（1996）和Hofbauer（2003）提出的思想，本文定义了有限博弈中的纳什均衡为可持续的，如果它可以通过删除/添加一部分对该均衡为劣等回应的策略而成为某个博弈的唯一纳什均衡。本文证明了关于可持续均衡的一个结果，并利用该结果提供了一个精炼。我们的结果涉及Hofbauer-Myerson猜想，即关于均衡的可持续性与其指数之间的关系：对于一类一般博弈，一个均衡是可持续的当且仅当其指数为+1。von Schemde和von Stengel（2008）证明了该猜想对双矩阵博弈成立；我们证明该猜想对所有有限博弈成立。更确切地说，我们证明一个均衡是孤立的且指数为+1，当且仅当它可以通过添加有限多个对该均衡为劣等回应的策略而成为更大博弈中的唯一均衡。由我们的结果直接可得，可持续均衡不满足Mertens（1989a）所表述的博弈分解公理。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种精炼，称为强可持续均衡，并证明其存在于所有正则博弈中。

articles.title_en: Behavioral implementation under incomplete information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息下的行为实施
articles.abstract_en: We investigate implementation under incomplete information allowing for individuals' choices featuring violations of rationality. Our primitives are individuals' interim choices that do not have to satisfy the weak axiom of revealed preferences. In this setting, we provide necessary as well as sufficient conditions for behavioral implementation under incomplete information. We also introduce behavioral interim incentive Pareto efficiency and investigate its implementability under incomplete information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究不完全信息下的实施问题，允许个体的选择行为违反理性。我们的基本设定是个体的临时选择，这些选择不必满足显示偏好的弱公理。在此设定下，我们为不完全信息下的行为实施提供了必要条件和充分条件。我们还引入了行为临时激励帕累托效率，并研究了其在不完全信息下的可实施性。

articles.title_en: Competition in costly talk
articles.title_cn: 昂贵话语中的竞争
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a communication game between an uninformed decision maker and two perfectly informed senders with conflicting interests. Senders can misreport information at a cost that increases with the size of the misrepresentation. The main result concerns the characterization of equilibria with desirable properties: they always exist, are essentially unique, and are robust. Information transmission is partial in these equilibria, and persuasion occurs on the equilibrium path. By contrast, equilibria where the decision maker obtains her complete-information payoff are not robust, and hinge on beliefs with potentially undesirable properties.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个不知情的决策者与两个利益冲突且完全知情的发送者之间的沟通博弈。发送者可以虚报信息，其成本随虚报程度的增加而增加。主要结果涉及具有理想性质的均衡的表征：它们总是存在，本质上是唯一的，并且是稳健的。在这些均衡中，信息传递是部分的，并且说服发生在均衡路径上。相比之下，决策者获得其完全信息收益的均衡并不稳健，并且依赖于可能具有不良性质的信念。

articles.title_en: Inefficiency of Random Serial Dictatorship under incomplete information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息下随机序列独裁机制的低效率
articles.abstract_en: We study the problem of allocating n objects to n agents without monetary transfers in a setting where each agent's preference over objects is private. We assume that each agent's value vector (values for n objects) is independently drawn from an exchangeable distribution and show that the celebrated Random Serial Dictatorship mechanism is welfare inferior to another allocation method, the Random Boston mechanism, when the number of agents and objects is large. Specifically, every type of every agent has a strictly higher interim expected utility under the Random Boston mechanism than under the Random Serial Dictatorship mechanism. Moreover, this strict dominance holds even at the limit.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在没有货币转移的情况下将n个物品分配给n个代理人的问题，其中每个代理人对物品的偏好是私有的。我们假设每个代理人的价值向量（对n个物品的价值）独立地从可交换分布中抽取，并表明当代理人和物品数量较大时，著名的随机序列独裁机制在福利上劣于另一种分配方法，即随机波士顿机制。具体来说，每个代理人的每种类型在随机波士顿机制下的中期预期效用严格高于随机序列独裁机制下的效用。此外，这种严格优势即使在极限情况下也成立。

articles.title_en: Post-auction investment by financially constrained bidders
articles.title_cn: 财务受限投标人的拍卖后投资
articles.abstract_en: This study examines auctions in which the value of goods is endogenously determined by ex post investment while bidders face financial constraints. The main results are twofold. First, we characterize performance comparisons on revenue and investment between standard auctions. When the valuation is linear in investment, we have the equivalence theorem with respect to the seller's expected revenue and the winner's expected investment. When the valuation is concave in investment, the first-price auction yields higher expected revenue than the second-price auction. In addition, under additional conditions, the expected investment is larger in the second-price auction. Second, we analyze mechanisms other than simple auctions when sellers aim to promote investment. Scoring auctions increase the winner's investment at the expense of a decrease in revenue compared to price-only auctions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了商品价值由事后投资内生决定且投标人面临财务约束的拍卖。主要结果有两方面。首先，我们刻画了标准拍卖之间在收入和投资方面的绩效比较。当估值关于投资是线性的，我们得到了关于卖方预期收入和赢家预期投资的等价定理。当估值关于投资是凹的，第一价格拍卖产生的预期收入高于第二价格拍卖。此外，在附加条件下，第二价格拍卖中的预期投资更大。其次，当卖方旨在促进投资时，我们分析了简单拍卖之外的机制。与仅价格拍卖相比，评分拍卖增加了赢家的投资，但以收入减少为代价。

articles.title_en: A model of the formation of multilayer networks
articles.title_cn: 多层网络形成的模型
articles.abstract_en: We study the formation of multilayer networks where payoffs are determined by the degrees of players in each network. We begin by imposing either concavity or convexity in degree on the payoff function of the players. We then explore distinct network relationships that result from inter- and intra-network spillovers captured by the properties of supermodularity/submodularity and strategic complementarity respectively. We show the existence of equilibria and characterize them. Additionally, we establish both necessary and sufficient conditions for an equilibrium to occur. We also highlight the connection, in equilibrium, between inter-network externalities and the identity of linked players in one network given the identity of linked players in the other network. Furthermore, we analyze efficient multilayer networks. Finally, we extend our models to contexts with more than two layers, and scenarios where agents receive a bonus for being connected to the same individuals in both networks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究多层网络的形成，其中收益由玩家在每个网络中的度数决定。我们首先对玩家的收益函数施加度数的凹性或凸性。然后，我们探讨由网络间和网络内溢出效应所产生的不同网络关系，这些溢出效应分别通过超模性/子模性和策略互补性的性质来捕捉。我们证明了均衡的存在性并对其进行了刻画。此外，我们建立了均衡发生的必要条件和充分条件。我们还强调了在均衡中，网络间外部性与一个网络中链接玩家的身份（给定另一个网络中链接玩家的身份）之间的联系。进一步地，我们分析了有效的多层网络。最后，我们将模型扩展到超过两层的情境，以及代理人在两个网络中连接到相同个体时获得奖金的情景。

articles.title_en: Semi-endogenous or fully endogenous growth? A unified theory
articles.title_cn: 半内生还是完全内生增长？一个统一理论
articles.abstract_en: Is growth ultimately fully endogenous or semi-endogenous? Three decades of theoretical and empirical growth economics have kept both possibilities open. Here, R&D-driven growth is a general combination of both semi-endogenous and fully endogenous mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 增长最终是完全内生还是半内生的？三十年的理论和实证增长经济学使这两种可能性都保持开放。在此，研发驱动的增长是半内生和完全内生机制的一般组合。

articles.title_en: Sequentially mixed search and equilibrium price dispersion
articles.title_cn: 序贯混合搜索与均衡价格离散度
articles.abstract_en: Many markets feature sequentially mixed search (SMS), which is search directed toward a price distribution followed by noisy matching with multiple offers. I construct a tractable model of SMS, establish existence of a unique equilibrium, and prove that the equilibrium is constrained efficient. Although individuals on each side of the market are homogeneous and search is directed, the equilibrium has a non-degenerate and continuous distribution of posted prices on a connected support. Despite the possibility of multiple offers, the highest price is lower than the joint value of a match so that both sides of the market obtain strictly positive surpluses of trade at all equilibrium prices. This feature captures the common practice that searchers restrict search below a price bound. Moreover, I show that an increase in the meeting efficiency widens price dispersion, which helps explain the puzzling fact that the increased use of the Internet has not reduced price dispersion.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多市场具有序贯混合搜索（SMS）的特征，即针对价格分布的定向搜索，随后伴随多个报价的噪声匹配。我构建了一个易于处理的SMS模型，证明了唯一均衡的存在性，并证明了该均衡是约束有效的。尽管市场双方个体是同质的且搜索是定向的，均衡中在连通支撑上存在非退化且连续的报价分布。尽管可能存在多个报价，最高价格仍低于匹配的联合价值，因此市场双方在所有均衡价格下均获得严格正的交易剩余。这一特征捕捉了搜索者将搜索限制在价格界限以下的常见做法。此外，我表明匹配效率的提高会扩大价格离散度，这有助于解释互联网使用增加并未减少价格离散度这一令人困惑的事实。
